title: Sue Hikmah .
intro: Su lembut hikmah tom geubagi nasihat nyang meulangkah watee. Tokoh njoë, njang geubri beureukat deungon peungeurtian njang dalam, geupeusampoë peulajaran njang hana meuharga njang teutap djeuët keu lampu keu bandum ureuëng njang meuheut keu bimbingan. Jeuet neubuka identitas di likot kata-kata nyang abadi nyoe?
clues: Lon geubri nikmat njang meudalam nibak Allah, hadiah njang peu-trang haté dan pikéran ulôn.
Lon meugisa keu aneuk lon nyang lon gaséh, meuheut lon bagi harta nyang paleng meuhareuga nyang lon po.
Lon peuingat bahwa keu-hana-adelan nyang paleng brat na kheueh tapeudong mitra ngon Allah nyang Satu nyang beutôi.
Lon peuingat bahwa bah that pih saboh beuban saboh bijeh sawi, njang teusöm dalam batèë atawa di luwa langèt, akan geubri pertanggungjawaban lé Allah.
Lon peurintah beu wajib keu ureung chik, padahai ta’at nyan hanya lam hai keubeunaran.
Lon peurunoe sopan santun nyang sederhana: jak ngon miyueb até ateueh bumoe dan moderat su gata; sabab su nyang paleng kreueh na kheueh su keuleudée.

trial.label: Sidang / Acara
options: Meubri naseuhat nyang meudalam keu aneuk gobnyan .
Peugot kapai mangat seulamat nibak ie raya .
Meutahan peunyaket nyang brat deungon saba .
Teurimong tablet ilahi bak saboh gunong .
trial.answer: Meubri naseuhat nyang meudalam keu aneuk gobnyan .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Naseuhat gobnyan geuabadikan lam kitab suci .
Gobnyan geubri keunabian dan huköm nyang barô .
Gobnyan jeuet keu sidroe peunguasa nyang peukasa ateueh saboh keurajeuen nyang luwah .
Gobnyan geupeubeuôt u syeuruga hana maté .
Gobnyan geuteurimong wahyu langsông nibak malaikat .
outcome.answer: Naseuhat gobnyan geuabadikan lam kitab suci .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
